note: What TLS the box's 443 and the two-device link must serve. tools/tls_policy.py judges a testssl.sh JSON result (tls.json) and the shipped Caddyfile against it. Protocol ids are testssl.sh's (SSLv2, SSLv3, TLS1, TLS1_1, TLS1_2, TLS1_3).

link.what: the two-device link's TLS port on TB_LINK_ADDR (tools/two_device.py, deploy/two-device/)

relaxation.note: H-48 (D-1328, amended 2026-11-19): the one supported relaxation, for a hospital's old client without an AEAD suite. off is the policy above and the only PASS; cbc is reported as the named exception (exit 3), never as a pass, and any other weakening still fails. The two-device link is never relaxed.

cbc.what: 443 also serves the four TLS 1.2 ECDHE suites with AES-CBC-SHA; still TLS 1.2/1.3 only, forward secrecy only, no static RSA, 3DES, RC4, export or NULL
